subject: Geografia
description_pt: Reconhecer a importância do solo e da água para a vida, identificando seus diferentes usos (plantação e extração de materiais, entre outras possibilidades) e os impactos desses usos no cotidiano da cidade e do campo.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes usos do solo e água em ambientes urbanos e rurais
components.description_en: Identify different uses of soil and water in urban and rural settings

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a importância do solo e água para sustentar a vida
components.description_en: Recognize the importance of soil and water for sustaining life
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish the roles of air, water, and soil in providing materials for plant growth

components.description_pt: Descrever impactos do uso do solo e água na vida cotidiana em ambientes urbanos e rurais
components.description_en: Describe impacts of soil and water use on daily life in urban and rural environments
components.cc_component_description: Identify ways human activities in agriculture, industry, and daily life affect Earth's systems

cc_matches.description: Plants acquire their material for growth chiefly from air and water.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
